data.name: Caribbean Prospector
data.detailed_description:
The Caribbean, 1669. Start with a small ship and build a career through trade, smuggling, piracy, exploration, and war. Every voyage is a gamble: make your fortune and retire — or lose ship, crew, and captain to the sea.

Build your own pirate career

  • Trade and smuggle between a living network of ports — 23 goods, prices that move whether you're there or not, customs searches you can bribe, dodge, or fight.
  • Hunt prizes as an outlaw pirate, serve a nation as a privateer with a letter of marque, chase a fortune as a merchant, chart the wild as a naturalist — or start shipwrecked with nothing but driftwood and stubbornness.
  • Recruit officers face by face off the waterfront, upgrade ships at the yard, and command a growing fleet with captains you appoint.

Fight for every prize

  • Exchange tactical broadsides — round shot breaks hulls, chain shreds rigging, grape sweeps decks — then close and grapple.
  • Boarding is a top-down deck fight: two hulls lashed together, your actual crew crossing the planks beside you. Fell her captain and the crew strikes at once.
  • Take her as a prize for the Admiralty Court, commission her into your fleet — or retreat before the sea claims both ships.

Play the voyage you want

  • A full career sandbox with an optional nine-stage main quest — or a focused 20-minute Short Voyage when that's the evening you have.
  • Story difficulty to learn the ropes, Captain as the intended experience, Ironman when you want the sea to mean it.
  • Painted tiles or classic terminal glyphs — surf, storms, and muzzle flashes, or the sharp readable grid roguelikes are loved for.
  • Full controller and Steam Deck support with official layouts; keyboard-first on desktop; Windows, macOS, and Linux.



Ashore, the islands are their own game: forage, mine, cook at a campfire, fight jaguars and raiders, dig up buried treasure, and describe the wildlife in a field-journal codex — describe every species and be elected a Fellow of the Royal Society. Retire in glory with estates and a title, or go down with the ship. Both end with your tale told.

A spiritual successor to Prospector, magellan's cult sci-fi terminal roguelike — its spirit of open-ended captaincy, recast under a Caribbean sun. In Early Access since August 2026, with updates landing almost daily — most of them straight from player reports.

data.short_description: Captain a ship in a turn-based pirate roguelike set in 1669. Trade and smuggle across a living Caribbean, fire broadsides, board prizes with your crew, explore islands, and retire rich—or sink trying. Play with painted tiles or classic terminal glyphs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU capable of 1280x720 display
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 11 or newer (Apple Silicon)
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU capable of 1280x720 display
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux with glibc 2.31+ (SteamOS 3 supported)
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core CPU
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU capable of 1280x720 display
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Launches in the native SDL renderer; a terminal renderer and pure-ASCII mode remain available as fallbacks.
